name: Meshrin

abilities.name: Fear Aura
abilities.description: Meshrin emanates an aura in a 20-foot radius while it is not incapacitated. Any enemy that starts its turn in the aura must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Great Weapon Master
abilities.description: When Meshrin hits a creature with its Greataxe, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

abilities.name: Mire Stride
abilities.description: Meshrin ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Fleet Agility (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Meshrin takes the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Meshrin makes three attacks, using Greataxe or Javelin. It can replace one attack with a use of Frightening Roar.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage. Immediately after the attack, a javelin returns to Meshrin's grasp, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Meshrin's next turn.

actions.name: Splintering Throw (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Meshrin hurls a javelin at a point it can see within 90 feet. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 (14d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is Large or smaller, it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Frightening Roar
actions.description: Each creature of Meshrin's choice in a 30-foot radius originating from Meshrin that can see or hear it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's terror for 24 hours.

unplaced.clause: He is a barbarian who rages
unplaced.text: Meshrin has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage it takes is reduced by 3.
